markets.title: Bitcoin price on Sep 11, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the simple average of the sixty seconds of CF Benchmarks' Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) before 5 PM EDT is above 75999.99 at 5 PM EDT on Sep 11, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Will the rate of CPI inflation be above 3.4% for the year ending in August 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than 3.4% in the twelve months ending August 2026 (as represented by the one-decimal place value reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics), then the market resolves to Yes.
